title: Tauq-o-Zanjeer Kujaa Abid-e-beemaar Kujaa
body:
Tauq-o-Zanjeer Kujaa Abid-e-beemaar Kujaa
Momino tumko sunaatha hoon main ek aisa bayaan
Jiskay sunney sey jigar aab ho aansoo ho ravaan
Aag khaimoun mein lagi saari fizaa mein hai dhuvaan
Paaye Sajjad kujaa vaadi-e-purqaar kujaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Qasim-e-khastha jigar aah Hasan kay mehroo
Kartey hain tujh pey sitam hadh sey siwaa run mein adoo
Chaand sey chehrey pah doobey huvey khoon mein gaisoo
Jism-e-majrooh kujaa ghodon ki yalgaar kujaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Bey ridaa aah huva Zainab-e-mazloom ka sar
Saaya-e-chaadar-e-Tatheer magar tha sar par
Dar badar phirthi rahi Shaam mein bint-e-Haider
Ghamzadaa Banu kujaa shiddath-e-apkaar kujaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Purzay purzay huvey Quran-e-wafaa kay paarey
Zulm sehtay rahey Sarwar kay harum beychaarey
Chhinkar baandhay Sakina ko tamaachey maarey
Panja-e-zulm kujaa Phool sey rukhsaar kujaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Fatema Zehra ka aaya jo mazaar-e-aqdhas
Boli Zainab yeh bhatijeh sey huvi main beykas
Chodd doh mujhko akeila kay kahoongi az bas
Maa ki aaghoush kujaa dukhtar-e-naachaar kujaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Hurmula tujhko na shashmaahey ka kuch aaya khayaal
Khoon-e-Asghar sey kiya hai rukh-e-Shabbir ko laal
Aaj taariq ka hai tujhsey musalsil yeh sawaal
Halq-e-Masoom kujaa teer-e-sitamgaar kujaa
Khwaab mein aaye Sakina ko nazar uskay pidar
Khoyi khoyi si thi yoon baali Sakina ki nazar
Jaisey ek bhattka musaafir ho sareh raaha guzar
Laasha-e-Shah kujaa bachchi ka afkaar kujaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Dasht mein shaam-e-gharibaan jo ghariboun ki huvi
Pehra deinay kay liye utthi Ali ki beti
Aaya Zainab ko nazar ek sawaar-e-arabi
Dasht-e-purqaar kujaa Haider-e-Karrar kujaa
